title: Xatryx bio-based PTMEG: first commercial batches

research.what: CovationBio developed a new process to make bio-based THF and PTMEG, a drop-in replacement for fossil PTMEG used in spandex, polyurethanes and elastomers. Origin: CovationBio's in-house C4 platform process technology (described as new-to-the-world). The start year is not stated in the sources, so 2026 is a placeholder, not a verified date.

change.what: The 50,000 t/yr Qidong plant in China made its first commercial on-spec batches of Xatryx bioTHF and bioPTMEG in August 2026, and the first partly bio-based athletic insole using it was shown in September.

note: This is the first commercial-scale production of non-food bio-based PTMEG, a key spandex and polyurethane building block. The research start year is unverified.
